notes: Buying Pro is now one step from anywhere Crisp says a feature is part of Pro: the Max quality and batch messages open the unlock window, which leads with the price — $129 once, or four payments of $32.25 with Klarna or Afterpay in the US — and the founding price of $64.50 for the first 25 buyers, applied at checkout. When a free export finishes, the result panel says the file carries the “Made with Crisp” mark and offers to remove it. On a Mac with less than 48 GB of memory, the window says up front that Max quality works on photos and single frames. Activation problems now point to support@crispvideo.app.
